environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. Service runs in a VPC with access to internal services including the EC2 metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254). No egress filtering applied. ALB forwards all traffic to the service on port 3000. No additional middleware or security headers configured at the infrastructure level.

config.network: VPC with default route table, no egress restrictions, IMDSv1 enabled on task role
config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules, no WAF attached
config.headers: No additional response headers injected by infrastructure
config.metadata_service: EC2-compatible metadata at 169.254.169.254 accessible from container
